gsm_guide.180: Standard weight — everyday tees, light and breathable, like a regular store-bought tee
gsm_guide.200: Standard+ — sublimation printing specifically, cotton-feel polyester
gsm_guide.210: Mid-weight — premium oversized tees, like H&M/Zara quality, noticeable weight
gsm_guide.220: Mid-weight — structured honeycomb polo fabric, has body and form
gsm_guide.240: Heavyweight — thick, structured drape, gold standard for streetwear brands (like Stussy/Fear of God)
gsm_guide.320: Heavy fleece — warm, soft brushed inside, hoodies/sweatshirts/winter wear
gsm_guide.430: Ultra-heavy — thickest blank hoodie in India, like wearing a blanket, extreme cold weather

fabric_features.biowash: Enzyme-washed for softness and pre-shrunk finish — no shrinkage after washing
fabric_features.supercombed: Premium combed cotton — smoother, stronger yarn, Red Label quality
fabric_features.drop_shoulder: Oversized relaxed fit style popular in streetwear, wider shoulder line
fabric_features.loopknit: Knitting method that creates loops on inside for softness
fabric_features.brushed: Fabric brushed on inside for fleece-like warmth (hoodies/sweatshirts)

printing_compatibility.screen_print: Best on 100% cotton, higher GSM = better. Recommended: Oversize 240gsm, True Biowash RN
printing_compatibility.dtg: All 100% cotton products. Pre-treated cotton for vibrant digital prints
printing_compatibility.dtf: ALL products work great — cotton and cotton-polyester blends
printing_compatibility.sublimation: ONLY Sublimation T-Shirt (200gsm) for full sublimation
printing_compatibility.embroidery: High GSM products — Premium Polo, Hoodie 320gsm, Oversize 240gsm, Varsity Jacket
printing_compatibility.htv_heat_press: All products, especially 240gsm+ for best results
